sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, MAX(movement_date) AS latest_movement_date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND movement_date < DATE '2026-11-01') AS october_movement_count, ROUND(SUM(brl_amount) FILTER (WHERE movement_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND movement_date < DATE '2026-11-01')::numeric, 2) AS october_signed_brl_amount, clock_timestamp() AS observed_at FROM public.rpt_inflow__movement_adjusted;
